text: dsh-moa-native（DSH 网页端插件）：通过 DSH 的模型 provider 接入 Mixture-of-Agents 流程，让多个参考模型并行生成建议，再由选定的聚合模型结合完整工具能力处理用户请求。它提供配方式模型选择、参考视野与注入设置、节奏控制、会话运行轨迹面板和实时状态栏，也支持 /moaR 与 /moaF 临时切换参考模式。适合希望在 DSH 会话中结合多模型意见的用户；需要自行配置可用的模型 provider 与模型。

dsh-moa-native adds a Mixture-of-Agents provider to DSH. Reference models advise in parallel; one aggregator responds with tools. Configure recipes, prompts, and cadence in settings. A trace panel and live dock show progress. Use /moaR or /moaF to switch modes. Configure your own models.
想让几个模型先分别看看我的问题，再由一个模型整合处理。
DSH 能不能在每轮对话里自动收集其他模型的建议？
我想给主模型配一组并行的参考模型。
让不同模型按设定节奏检查当前会话，再继续执行。
有没有办法查看每个参考模型本轮花了多久、给了什么意见？
我想在网页端调整模型阵容和提示注入内容。
I want several models to advise one model during each DSH turn.
Can I inspect which reference models responded and what guidance they produced?
dsh-moa-native 的功能「并行参考建议」：请求处理时调用配置的参考模型并收集建议，再交给聚合模型生成回复；可在配方中设置参考阵容与注入方式。
dsh-moa-native 的功能「节奏与复用」：可按用户轮次、迭代次数或分层节拍安排参考调用，并在未到调用节拍时复用最近一次建议。
dsh-moa-native 的功能「模型配方控制台」：在设置页选择参考模型、聚合模型、模式和节奏，保存后更新配置；配方也作为模型项供会话选择。
dsh-moa-native 的功能「运行轨迹查看」：记录会话轮次及参考路、聚合路的状态和耗时，并在面板和输入区状态栏显示过程摘要。
dsh-moa-native 使用前须知：运行轨迹默认可写入用户目录下的压缩归档；配置 trace=false 可停用轨迹记录。见 host.mjs:178-188。

dsh-moa-native README · What it solves：A single model has blind spots. In long sessions you want a few models reviewing the situation behind every reply — without switching tools, copy-pasting, or giving up tool use. dsh-moa-native internalizes that loop: **picking one model entry runs the whole MoA pipeline for the session**.

dsh-moa-native README · What it solves：```
user message ──► refs consulted in parallel (private drafts, mutually unaware)
                      │
                      ▼
                guidance injected as a trailing message (never pollutes session

dsh-moa-native README · Recommended mode (advanced)：Full part-by-part, parameter-by-parameter walkthrough: [architecture.svg](docs/architecture.svg).

dsh-moa-native README · Tiered rhythm (v4.4.0)：**Heavy models steer every *m* steps, flash models patrol every *n* steps, and every other step reuses the last beat — free while that beat is still cached (a cache miss refills with the patrol roster).**

dsh-moa-native README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-moa-native
```

Restart the instance and refresh the browser.

dsh-moa-native README · Quick start：1. Settings → **MoA-Native console**: pick 3-4 reference routes (flash tiers work well — fast and cheap) and one aggregator (the model you want to keep). **This step is mandatory on first install** — the factory lineup is only an example and must point at your own configured providers/models. Since references are framed as the aggregator's own pre-run drafts, you can skip a ref that shares the aggregator's model (saves one route).
2. Save (hot-reloads), then select a **moa-native** entry in the session model picker — `default` or any recipe you saved.
3. Chat normally. Fusion happens every turn; `/moaR` `/moaF` temporarily switch the **reference view** (lineup, aggregator, and cadence stay with the current entry; the console shows the live *slash preview*). Subagent sessions stream straight through the aggregator by default (zero fanout) — switch via the *subagent gating* dropdown (7 tiers: 3/5/8/10/15/20/30).

dsh-moa-native README · Highlights：**Config as model** — `default` and every recipe appear as model entries on the provider page; a recipe is a full preset (lineup, mode, cadence, params).

**Three-level model picker** (identical to the session UI) — provider → model → effort for every route.

**Injection modules** — each route's trailing note is a visible, editable text module: built-in default (Hermes-style), blank (zero injection), or any custom one. No hidden personas, no output-length contracts.

dsh-moa-native README · Highlights：**Two reference modes**:
- **F · full mirror** — references see exactly what the acting model sees; KV prefix cache hit rates above 90%
- **R · trimmed view** — Hermes-style tool-result trimming with input budgets

**Subagent gating** — MoA applies to the main session by default; subagent sessions pass straight through the aggregator, with an optional every-N-steps upgrade. Design rationale: [SUBAGENT-GATING-DESIGN.md](docs/SUBAGENT-GATING-DESIGN.md).

dsh-moa-native README · Highlights：**Run traces** — four-level drill-down: sessions (workspace-isolated) → turns → per-model cards → full advisory text. Cold-start backfill from daily zstd archives; **inputs are never persisted**.

**Fail-loud** — a failing reference route is reported as-is, never silently replaced.

dsh-moa-native README · Theory positioning：Comparison with the MoA paper (arXiv:2406.04692), Hermes `/moa`, and community dsh-moa plugins — inheritance, superseding forms, and honest boundaries: [THEORY-POSITION.md](docs/THEORY-POSITION.md).

dsh-moa-native README · Configuration：`~/.dsh/profiles/web/moa-native.config.json` (panel saves hot-reload):

```jsonc
{
  "refs": [                                 // direct lineup; or use named recipes
    "provider-a/model-flash@high",          // string = default injection
    { "model": "provider-b/model-x@max", "injection": "__blank__" } // object = explicit injection module
